items.answer: ToolFrame offers a Loan Repayment Calculator for estimating monthly payments and amortization schedules, a Compound Interest Calculator for projecting investment growth over time, and a Salary Calculator for understanding net vs. gross salary with tax breakdowns.

items.answer: Yes, all financial calculators on ToolFrame are completely free to use with no registration required. You can perform unlimited calculations at any time.

items.answer: Our calculators use standard financial formulas — such as the amortization formula for loans and compound interest formulas for investments. items.question: What energy tools does ToolFrame offer?
items.answer: ToolFrame offers a Solar Panel Energy Estimator that calculates annual and monthly solar production, self-consumption rates, system costs, and 25-year return on investment based on your location and system configuration.

items.question: How accurate is the solar energy estimation?
items.answer: The estimator uses region-specific solar irradiance data (kWh/kWp values) and accounts for panel degradation over 25 years, energy price increases, battery impact, and local subsidy programs to provide realistic projections.

items.question: Does the estimator account for battery storage?
items.answer: Yes. You can toggle battery storage on or off and set the capacity. The tool compares scenarios with and without battery, showing how storage affects self-consumption rates and overall savings.

items.question: Will more energy tools be added?
items.answer: Yes, we plan to expand our energy tools section with additional calculators for different renewable energy sources and energy efficiency analysis.
